entities.summary: Lake Nyuk(Russian: Нюк, Finnish and Karelian: Nuokkijärvi) is a large freshwater lake in the Republic of Karelia, northwestern part of Russia. It is located at 64.45°N 31.75°E and has an area of 214–230 km2 (83–89 sq mi). There are numerous islands on the lake. The lake is part of the Kem River basin.
